verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Aider letting a developer sign in with an existing product subscription plan to power the agent; the documented paths are LLM APIs and local models. The copy/paste-to-web-chat mode is an adjacent manual workflow. It is not subscription sign-in, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent
